name: Remember My Txt
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: DuncanRuns
description: Remember My Txt makes sure unrecognized values in the options.txt file get saved when changing other options, preventing things like losing keybinds when you are waiting for a mod to port to a newer version of Minecraft.
roadmap: Minecraft's libraries and client API (0.2), Mixin (0.5)
